name: consignment-packing-app
description: Modern full-stack consignment packing station application with Firebase

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:security: cd backend && JWT_SECRET=${JWT_SECRET:-test-only-jwt-secret-ci-do-not-use-in-production} NODE_ENV=${NODE_ENV:-test} npm run test:security && cd ../frontend && npm run test:security
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
